context.text: Amavas ki vo rat thi. Me aur meri dost manasvi, ham neche thehl ne gaye the . Barrish ke karan buliding ke neeche koi nahi tha. Pura illaka sun san tha uss rat. <NAME_B> this girl is seriously miracle to my life. Earlier I have all bad experience with most girls, they usually use me and throw after they have satisfied. But she was different. My mentality was like every girl is selfish and full of attitude, doesn't care for anyone and many more. But rutuja was different.she forced to change my mind set.
We just have one month difference in us she was my birth mate . Mummy tolds me about myself and about her, that her grandmother used to take care when mummy used to go outside and she used to cry. I also remember one day in childhood when she had visited and there was a cycle in our home and we were riding and really having fun. But this was very small memories we had earlier. Actually destiny make us to know about each other when we actually met and talked when we both were mature. At that time it was free talk about all things for literally 2 hrs . We shared our insta id . Then numbers ,then chatting,then calls. And this journey was different. We were connected with this digital things even now we had very less amount or negligible after our first met.rutu means season or weather she actually changes my mood whenever i talk with her. Every person wants to tell his side of story or he doesn't want to listen to other person but she has the ability to listen all my stupid stuff. No one is actually interested in this stuff that's why I have very less amount of friends.But now I can say I have the best . She is been my important person of life . In a day many times things happen that I want to tell her but as I listen her voice I forgot those things and our talks remain silent 😂.I decided to talk just 2 days in a week because of this we both will respect each other time.On chats usually we don't talk we just fights. And these fights usually start because of me. I don't usually fight with anyone but I think we are really very much connected that these fights create our bond more strong. Shaaranya and me used to fight in childhood and this childish things are coming out. Everyone wants there childhood back but we are enjoying this present. These are some people which very much important in my life our for example mummy,papa, shaaranya,riya, family members, mahaveer,rutuja, vipul. I don't want to loose anyone, thinking anyone is hell. Their value of is unexplainable in our life. Because all these are very much important.I just have fear of losing or hurting them unknowingly. But these are all people where I can express myself freely. I can express all my emotions to some people like rutuja, mahaveer because all they know my problems . This doesn't mean I should use them for my anger or express emotions,this is totally wrong. But this happens majority of the time and the realisation hits me after I have done the mistake. I am trying to control this but sometimes it goes out of control.
At the end explaining rutuja how she is important to me is very difficult remembering all this things really make my eyes num and making it hard explaining how important someone can be.Words are really less to express it but I have tried my best
